pr_title: Adding test coverage for host builder properties
pr_body:
- Adds test coverage to make sure properties are propagated through callbacks.

Closes #36197
pr_comments:
> Will we get any value out of adding a scenario to validate that the build.Properties.Add("foo", "bar") scenario works?

I don't think so, we're not using a custom dictionary or anything. Add vs set in this case is equivalent.

> I don't think so, we're not using a custom dictionary or anything. Add vs set in this case is equivalent.

I was moreso referring to testing `builder.Properties` vs `builder.Host.Properties`.
And you better not have a merge conflict 😄

@davidfowl backporting to release/6.0 failed, the patch most likely resulted in conflicts:
